gaps.title: Texas registry lists 1,302 Tesla Robotaxis, including 573 Cybercabs, just ahead of Waymo
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 10 TxDMV count is 729 Model Ys plus 573 Cybercabs versus Waymo's 1,297, and registrations are not active riders

gaps.title: Bloomberg says a Tesla-SpaceX merger could be announced in December
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Boards are on terms and governance; China operations versus SpaceX defense work is the open hurdle, and Terafab is cited as shared work
